summary_en: This study tests BNT314 together with pumitamig (BNT327) and chemotherapy in people with metastatic colorectal cancer. Most study drugs are given by intravenous infusion, and one chemotherapy drug can be given by mouth; how long or how often is not stated. The main outcome measured is not stated in the record; the study is Phase 1/2.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa BNT314 en combinación con pumitamig (BNT327) y quimioterapia en personas con cáncer colorrectal metastásico. La mayoría de los medicamentos del estudio se administran por infusión intravenosa, y un medicamento de quimioterapia puede tomarse por vía oral; la duración o la frecuencia no se indican. El resultado principal que se mide no se indica en el registro; el estudio es de fase 1/2.
who_for: Unresectable adenocarcinoma of the colon or rectum, confirmed by tumor tissue
Non-MSI-H or pMMR colorectal cancer confirmed by approved or local testing
Measurable disease according to RECIST v1.1
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1 and life expectancy of at least 12 weeks
not_for: Confirmed MSI-H or dMMR colorectal cancer
Prior EpCAM or 4-1BB targeted therapy or immunotherapy
Prior immune checkpoint inhibitor or PD-L1/VEGF bispecific antibody
Candidate for locoregional treatment with curative (radical) intent, per investigator
